faq.q: Google says “Processed zero events.” Should I import again?
faq.a: First check the calendar selected as the import destination. Google says this message can appear after a second click on Import when the first import already succeeded. Look for the expected events before retrying. The message alone does not prove that events are missing, and it is not a guarantee that repeated imports always avoid duplicates. If the result is still unclear, follow Google’s computer-based import troubleshooting and compare the destination before deleting anything.
